documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 577.9 crore for FY19 and initiated FY20 with double-digit growth during the summer season. International business expanded by 54% in FY19 to cross $20 million, contributing over 25% of total revenues. Management plans to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure during FY20 and expand sales generating assets.

guidance.claim: Vadilal expects to deliver double-digit growth with margin expansion driven by a higher contribution from international business.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company intends to consider price increases in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
guidance.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects another good year in FY20 as it leverages the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Continued focus on developing the domestic business along with lower input costs is expected to drive growth.
guidance.quote: Continued focus on developing domestic business and lower input costs expected to drive growth

guidance.claim: Vadilal maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better consumption environment, demand shift to the organized sector, and international traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption in core markets faced Q4 weakness owing to severe weather that extended winter through March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International business growth was driven by strong demand for ice creams and other products among the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other regions.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit summer season growth and 25% international revenue expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business revenue growth in Q3 FY19 was driven by higher sales volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business was driven by higher volumes

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic growth is reverting to historical trends after a temporary impact from changes in consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: During Q2 FY19, ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9%, backed by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% international volume expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenues from the international business grew by 53% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: International business revenues grew by 53% yoy

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues accounted for 32% of turnover during Q2 FY19.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal estimated its capex for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: Vadilal will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand, and distribution.
capex_expansion.quote: Will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand and distribution

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material costs, and higher international realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: People resource costs increased significantly last year, largely due to U.S. operations expanding to over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points while profit after tax more than doubled in FY19.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Vadilal has visibility of stable raw material costs covered through Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded to 50% in Q3 FY19 compared to 40% in Q3 FY18.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: For the first nine months of FY19, gross margin expanded to 49% from 43% in 9M FY18.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Key supply arrangements closed for the upcoming summer season provide clear visibility on input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvements were achieved through volume growth, utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement costs, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material procurement prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit future margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over recent years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is currently present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

capital_allocation.claim: Vadilal reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long-tenure loans and reduce borrowing costs.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Operational surplus will be leveraged to restructure debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion and working capital improvements allow the company to continue debt rationalization.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: An extended winter through March impacted ice cream consumption across core domestic markets in Q4.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher current milk prices are driving plans to consider price increases in H2.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business growth was temporarily impacted by recent changes in the operating environment and consumption spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Vadilal estimated total capex for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
